text: 创业黑马公告，公司拟通过发行股份及支付现金方式购买北京版信通技术有限公司100%股权，并向不超过35名特定投资者发行股票募集配套资金。公司于2026年9月21日收到深圳证券交易所并购重组审核委员会审议结果，本次交易符合重组条件和信息披露要求，尚需获得中国证券监督管理委员会同意注册的决定后方可实施。
text_en: Chuangye Heima announced that the company plans to purchase 100% equity of Beijing Banxintong Technology Co., Ltd. through the issuance of shares and payment of cash, and to issue shares to no more than 35 specific investors to raise supporting funds. On September 21, 2026, the company received the review results of the Merger, Acquisition and Reorganization Review Committee of the Shenzhen Stock Exchange. This transaction meets the reorganization conditions and information disclosure requirements, and still needs to obtain the decision of the China Securities Regulatory Commission agreeing to registration before it can be implemented.
